text: Want bigger arms? Your triceps are two-thirds of them.
Every triceps exercise straightens your elbow. Where your arm is changes which part works most.
Pushdowns hit the outer heads. Overhead extensions stretch the long head. Skull crushers sit in between. And dips or close-grip bench let you go heavy.
One overhead move and one pushdown, and your triceps are covered.
